title: Extension by zero preserves constant-local-model constructibility
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$ and a field $k$ of characteristic $p>0$ with $p\ne\ell$, and let $j\colon U\hookrightarrow X$ be an open immersion of separated finite-type $k$-schemes, as in [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]. Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring], put $\Lambda_T=p_T^*\Lambda$ for $T=U,X$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients], and let $j_!\colon\Mod_{\Lambda_U}\to\Mod_{\Lambda_X}$ be the extension by zero of module objects [sk-def-sfb-module-lower-shriek].

Let $M$ be a $\Lambda_U$-module that is constructible in the sense of [sk-def-sfb-constructible]: there is a finite stratification $U=\coprod_aU_a$ [def-constructible-stratification] by constructible locally closed subschemes such that each $M|_{U_a}$ has a finite constant local model [det-def-sfb-constructible-local-model]. Then $j_!M$ is a constructible $\Lambda_X$-module in the same sense. More precisely, the subschemes $U_a$, viewed in $X$, together with the closed complement $Z=X\setminus U$ with its reduced subscheme structure [def-pc-reduced-scheme], form a finite stratification of $X$ by constructible locally closed subschemes; for every $a$ the restriction $(j_!M)|_{U_a}$ is isomorphic, as a $\Lambda_{U_a}$-module, to $M|_{U_a}$, and $(j_!M)|_Z=0$. The cases $U=\varnothing$ (then $M=0$ and $j_!M=0$) and $U=X$ (then $Z=\varnothing$) are included.
